title: Return Prep Time Trend
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=turbotax:return prep_minutes=* tax_year=*
| timechart span=1y avg(prep_minutes) as avg_prep, max(prep_minutes) as worst_prep by filing_status
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends average and maximum TurboTax return preparation minutes by filing status across tax years.
value: Prep-time drift shows when life complexity outgrew DIY and a CPA might save hours and mistakes.
implementation: Log `prep_minutes` and `filing_status` on each return session and compare year-over-year averages.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of prep minutes by filing status.
grandmaExplanation: It counts whether doing your taxes yourself is taking longer each year.
